LightningComponentBundle.description: Topbar with show/hide, fixed position, drawer and navigation menus.

property.name: navigationName
property.label: Navigation Menu Name
property.description: Name of the navigation menu to display.

property.name: fixed
property.label: Fixed Mode
property.description: If true, the topbar will follow the user scroll.

property.name: hideOnScroll
property.label: Hide/Show on Scroll
property.description: If true, the topbar will hide when scrolling down and reappear when scrolling up.

property.name: responsiveHeight
property.label: Responsive Height
property.description: Same as above but this only applies to the responsive breakpoint.

property.name: maxLinksDesktop
property.label: Max Links Visible on Topbar
property.description: Maximum amount of links allowed to appear on the topbar menu for desktop breakpoint.

property.name: userOnTopbar
property.label: User on Topbar
property.description: If true, will display login/logout options as well as a welcome message to logged in users on the topbar.

property.name: showDrawerDesktop
property.label: Show Drawer on Desktop
property.description: If true, will display the responsive drawer menu on desktop.

property.name: color
property.label: Item Color
property.description: Color for items on the topbar (Links, Hamburger button, User Message).

property.name: colorHover
property.label: Item Hover Color
property.description: Color for clickable items on the topbar when hovered.

property.name: transparentAtTop
property.label: Transparent When On Top
property.description: Will make the topbar background transparent and change the color of items when the user is at the top of the page. (Useful for mixing with a hero with background media or color)

property.name: colorWhenTransparent
property.label: Item Color When Transparent
property.description: Color for items when the topbar is transparent at the top of the page.

property.name: logoOverride
property.label: Logo Override
property.description: Set to a CSS variable containing the image to use.

property.name: logoWidth
property.label: Logo Width
property.description: Width of the logo displayed on the topbar.

property.name: logoHeight
property.label: Logo Height
property.description: Height of the logo displayed on the topbar.

property.name: logoColor
property.label: Logo Color
property.description: Changes the color of the logo by applying a mask. (Works well only if your logo was uploaded in SVG format)

property.name: linkAlignment
property.label: Link Alignment
property.description: Changes where the navigation links show up in the topbar.

property.name: linkHoverStyle
property.label: Link Style
property.description: Style of the navigation links when hovered.

property.name: dropLinkHoverStyle
property.label: Dropdown Link Style
property.description: Style of the navigation links from submenus when hovered.
